neighbours.label: a token in text about weight training and strength exercise (dumbbells, bench presses, squats, free weights)
fire: She curls heavy dumbbells for an hour at the gym every morning.
He can deadlift four hundred pounds and press two hundred more.
Beginners should start with light barbells and a spotter nearby.
Olympic weightlifters train the clean and jerk for years.
Add more weight to the bar when your squats feel easy.
Lifting free weights builds more strength than using machines.
ダンベルとバーベルで筋肉を鍛えます。
Three sets of heavy bench presses left his arms shaking.
quiet: She rides a stationary bike for an hour at the gym every morning.
He can run four hundred meters and swim two hundred more.
Beginners should start with short jogs and a coach nearby.
Olympic sprinters train the starting blocks for years.
Add more laps to the pool when your strokes feel easy.
Cycling long routes builds more stamina than using treadmills.
ジョギングと水泳で健康を保ちます。
Three sets of hard tennis matches left his legs shaking.
